0022600009.text: The Houston Rockets (1-0, first in the Southwest, 3rd in the West) visit the San Antonio Spurs (0-1, fourth in the Southwest and one game back, 10th in the West). Houston's Reed Sheppard (knee bruise) and Steven Adams (calf soreness) are both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and has Tobias Harris (calf strain) as a day-to-day game-time decision. The Spurs beat the Rockets 145-120 in their last meeting, on March 8 in San Antonio, and Houston lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, with no games yet between the teams this season.
